query: What correction methods best mitigate off-policy replay bias when reusing transitions collected under different preferences: importance sampling, per-preference replay partitions, prioritized by w, or short on-policy fine-tuning?

response.query: What correction methods best mitigate off-policy replay bias when reusing transitions collected under different preferences: importance sampling, per-preference replay partitions, prioritized by w, or short on-policy fine-tuning?
response.answer: Importance sampling and per-preference replay partitions best mitigate off-policy replay bias. Prioritized replay by w and short on-policy fine-tuning are less effective for this purpose.
